describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on pale ground with small tufts of grass under its paws. It has the overall body shape, dense shaggy fur, head and limbs of a brown bear with dark brown fur on the back and legs and lighter tan fur on the underbelly and muzzle, combined with glossy dark reddish-brown chitinous features. A single large curved glossy black horn rises from the center of its forehead, and multiple hard, shiny, segmented plates are embedded in the fur across its back, sides, neck, hips and outer leg joints. A row of six small oval black openings is visible in the light fur on the lower flank beneath the largest side plate. The head has a bear-like snout with a black nose, small dark eyes, and rounded furry ears, and each broad paw bears long pale claws.

describe.description: A large four-legged furry brown bear-like creature standing in side view facing right. Its body, head, legs and paws are covered in shaggy brown fur with a lighter tan muzzle and underbelly, like a grizzly bear. A single long glossy dark brown curved beetle horn with barbs rises from its forehead. Multiple glossy dark brown segmented beetle-like shell plates sit on its back, sides, shoulders, neck, rump and upper legs, and a row of six small black oval spots runs along its lower side beneath the largest plate.
